construction.current: Exact locked GRAM serialization and Collator path.
construction.metadata_first_full: For every fine history passage, move the unchanged metadata string before the unchanged ordered collaborative field; keep link, CF identities, raw components, passage count and 128-token budget fixed.
construction.all_recovered_mask: Within metadata_first, mask metadata token ranks that are visible there but exceed the number of metadata token ranks visible in the current serialization of the same passage.
construction.recovered_slice8: For every fine passage with at least eight newly recovered metadata tokens, mask the first eight recovered ranks; passages below that locked eligibility threshold contribute no slice mask in either slice condition.
construction.matched_visible_slice8: For each slice-eligible passage, mask the eight canonical metadata token ranks immediately before the current-visibility cutoff in metadata_first; token count and eligible-passage set exactly match recovered_slice8.
construction.target_independence: Serialization and masks use only item text, fixed CF identities, tokenizer offsets, and current visibility counts; no target token, rank, validation success, or test field is used.

decision_rule.execution_invalid: Any integrity, lineage, cohort, exact-repeat, localization, eligibility, finite-value, or resource-restoration check fails.
decision_rule.stop_no_net_value: Either dataset fails tail-miss net mean, strict lower CI, or positive-rate gate.
decision_rule.stop_no_recovered_value: Either dataset fails all-recovered mean/CI/positive-rate, recovered-slice8 mean/CI, or recovered contribution is less than half of net gain.
decision_rule.stop_broad_harm: Either dataset has tail-hit mean net reallocation below -0.01.
decision_rule.g1_design_allowed: All preceding gates pass on both datasets.

forbidden: changing top-k, context length, passage count, CF identity, metadata text, cohort, mask size, or thresholds after reading scores
using the matched control or one dataset to rescue a failed primary gate
